mapper.select: /* PlatformSmsMapper.selectPolicy */ SELECT P.PHONE_WINDOW_SEC AS phoneWindowSec , P.PHONE_HOUR_LIMIT AS phoneHourLimit , P.PHONE_DAY_LIMIT AS phoneDayLimit , P.IP_AXIS_ENABLED_YN AS ipAxisEnabledYn , P.IP_HOUR_LIMIT AS ipHourLimit , P.IP_DAY_LIMIT AS ipDayLimit , P.USER_HOUR_LIMIT AS userHourLimit , P.USER_DAY_LIMIT AS userDayLimit , P.GLOBAL_HOUR_LIMIT AS globalHourLimit , P.KILL_SWITCH_YN AS killSwitchYn , DATE_FORMAT(P.KILL_SWITCH_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS killSwitchAt , P.KILL_SWITCH_REASON AS killSwitchReason , DATE_FORMAT(P.KILL_SWITCH_RELEASE_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS killSwitchReleaseAt , P.KILL_SWITCH_RELEASE_NO AS killSwitchReleaseNo FROM TB_SMS_SEND_POLICY P WHERE P.POLICY_ID = 'DEFAULT'

/* PlatformSmsMapper.selectPolicyForUpdate */ SELECT P.PHONE_WINDOW_SEC AS phoneWindowSec , P.PHONE_HOUR_LIMIT AS phoneHourLimit , P.PHONE_DAY_LIMIT AS phoneDayLimit , P.IP_AXIS_ENABLED_YN AS ipAxisEnabledYn , P.IP_HOUR_LIMIT AS ipHourLimit , P.IP_DAY_LIMIT AS ipDayLimit , P.USER_HOUR_LIMIT AS userHourLimit , P.USER_DAY_LIMIT AS userDayLimit , P.GLOBAL_HOUR_LIMIT AS globalHourLimit , P.KILL_SWITCH_YN AS killSwitchYn , DATE_FORMAT(P.KILL_SWITCH_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS killSwitchAt , P.KILL_SWITCH_REASON AS killSwitchReason , DATE_FORMAT(P.KILL_SWITCH_RELEASE_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS killSwitchReleaseAt , P.KILL_SWITCH_RELEASE_NO AS killSwitchReleaseNo FROM TB_SMS_SEND_POLICY P WHERE P.POLICY_ID = 'DEFAULT' FOR UPDATE

/* PlatformSmsMapper.selectSendStat */ SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN S.SEND_STATUS = 'SENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sent , IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN S.SEND_STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed , IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN S.SEND_STATUS = 'SKIPPED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS skipped , IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN S.SEND_STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending , COUNT(1) AS total FROM TB_SMS_AUTH_CODE S WHERE S.INSERT_DATE >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR)
mapper.update: /* PlatformSmsMapper.releaseKillSwitch */ UPDATE TB_SMS_SEND_POLICY SET KILL_SWITCH_YN = 'N' , KILL_SWITCH_RELEASE_AT = NOW() , KILL_SWITCH_RELEASE_NO = #{operatorUserCd} , UPDATE_NO = #{operatorUserCd} , UPDATE_DATE = NOW() WHERE 1=1 AND POLICY_ID = 'DEFAULT' AND KILL_SWITCH_YN = 'Y'
